name: essentials
title: Essentials
concern: The built-in local utilities the agent ships with that need no account, network, or bridge: time and date, timers and alarms, and arithmetic.

categories.time: Time and date utilities: telling the current time or date, setting countdown timers, and setting alarms.
categories.calculator: Arithmetic: evaluating a numeric expression the user asks for — addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, powers and exponents, squares, cubes, square roots, cube roots, fractions, and percentages.
